title: One in a Million
subtitle: The maths of luck on Crossbones Isle
version_note: Chapter 7 Treasure Hunters mini-season, v43.00. Treasure odds as published by Epic Games on 7 November 2026; facts checked 12 November 2026.
description: An unofficial Fortnite fan book about luck: the real odds of every treasure in the Treasure Hunters season, the maths that explains them, a famously lucky match, and how to tell good thinking from superstition.
glossary_blurb: Every Word Watch word in this book, from A to Z. Words are the one treasure with a drop rate of 100 per cent: read one, and it's yours. Try to use three of them this week.

chapters.title: Feeling Lucky, Matey?
chapters.toc: What this book is about, and how it works
chapters.label: Start here
chapters.dek: A whole season built on luck, a list of numbers that shocked everybody, and the maths that makes sense of it all.

chapters.title: Chest Pains
chapters.toc: The seven treasures and their real odds
chapters.dek: Every chest on the Isle is a tiny lottery ticket. Here are the seven prizes, and the numbers Epic finally revealed.

chapters.title: One in What?
chapters.dek: What "1 in 137,500" really means, and how to picture a number that big using nothing but a coin.

chapters.title: At Least One, Me Hearties
chapters.toc: The chance of at least one, and the 400-chest table
chapters.dek: The cleverest trick in the whole of probability: to find the chance of winning, work out the chance of losing first.

chapters.title: Are We There Yet?
chapters.toc: Why an average is not a promise
chapters.dek: How long should a treasure take? The answer is an average, and an average is not a promise. Chests have no memory.

chapters.title: The Luckiest Match on the Isle
chapters.toc: Six treasures in one game: how rare was it?
chapters.dek: One squad, one match, treasure after treasure. Was it a miracle, a secret trick, or exactly what the maths expects?

chapters.title: Shiver Me Superstitions
chapters.toc: Hot tables, lucky rituals and rigged rumours
chapters.dek: Hot tables, pretending not to care, and the rumour that the whole hunt was rigged. Why clever brains believe strange things.

chapters.title: Happy Hour for Treasure
chapters.toc: Treasure Hours, multipliers and Sydney time
chapters.dek: For two hours the odds get better. How much better? And when exactly is nine o'clock at night in New York if you live in Sydney?

chapters.title: Worth Its Weight in Chug?
chapters.toc: Time, FOMO and choosing your own hunt
chapters.dek: Every hour you spend hunting is an hour you can't spend on anything else. How to decide what a treasure is really worth to you.

chapters.title: The Odds Lab
chapters.toc: Five experiments with coins, dice and chests
chapters.dek: Don't take our word for any of it. Five experiments you can run with a coin, two dice and a pencil.
